body:
One of our Haas VF-2SS YT mills (2015) has an HRT210 4th axis. Facts for the .mch variant and the post:
- The HRT210 axis is parallel to machine X. +A follows the right-hand rule about +X: a point on the part at +Y turns toward +Z.
- The axis is 211.7 mm above the table (we measured it; a probe gave 213.2). The unit sits on a riser, so it is approximately 60 mm higher than the 152.40 mm center height in the Haas specification. Thus the .mch needs the center height as a setting, not a fixed number.
- Our programs for this axis do not use G234 (TCPC) or G254 (DWO).
- The Haas classic manual (96-8000 rev V, January 2009) has G93 Inverse Time Feed Mode (Group 05). It also has Setting 34 (4th Axis Diameter): in feed-per-minute mode the control uses this diameter to calculate the angular feed rate.
- We need indexed work (3+1) first. Simultaneous 4-axis cuts come after that.

We can give more facts from this machine.
